items.headline: $OP Jumps 18%, Four-Week Rally Hits 66%
items.summary: $OP outpaced bitcoin and ether again, extending its four-week gain to 66% as Optimism momentum builds. Only $STRK posted a bigger multiweek rally.

items.headline: $JUP Rises 51% in Four Weeks Despite Fee Dip
items.summary: $JUP outpaced $BTC and $ETH over the past month even as Jupiter's product fees fell to $16.8M in the latest 28-day period.

items.headline: $APT Gains 51% in Four Weeks, Beats BTC and ETH
items.summary: $APT kept climbing with a 51% four-week gain, though stablecoin market cap on Aptos fell 17.5% over the same window.

items.headline: $CARDS Packs Hit $151M in Monthly Sales
items.summary: Collector Crypt logged $151M in monthly pack sales on Solana, with buyers doubling in Q3 — but just 548 wallets drove 83% of spending.

items.headline: Base Launches Earn & Borrow With $MORPHO
items.summary: Base introduced Earn & Borrow, letting apps embed variable-rate stablecoin lending and crypto-backed loans powered by $MORPHO and Aave.
